task_1_direct_channels.summary: PartitionedStore support was already wired in by a previous wave. DirectChannels.__init__() accepts optional partitioned_store parameter. When provided, uses partitioned_store.comms.conn for channels, presence, progress, read_offsets tables. Tracks connection ownership via _owns_conn flag (False when using shared partition connection). close() only closes the connection when _owns_conn is True. Full backwards compatibility: without partitioned_store, creates its own WAL-mode SQLite connection to db_path.
task_1_direct_channels.changes: Verified existing implementation is correct and complete. No additional changes needed.

task_2_work_stealing.summary: PartitionedStore support was already wired in by a previous wave for all three classes. WorkStealing and PipelineManager route to partitioned_store.queue.conn (queue partition for work_queue, pipelines, pipeline_stages). Scratchpad routes to partitioned_store.findings.conn (findings partition for scratchpad table). All three classes track _owns_conn and only close connections they own. Zombie reclaim thread works correctly with partitioned connections. Full backwards compatibility maintained.
task_2_work_stealing.changes: Verified existing implementation is correct and complete. No additional changes needed.

task_3_multi_team_runner.summary: Wired PartitionedStore into multi_team_runner.py. init_environment() now creates a PartitionedStore instance and passes it to all coordination module constructors. stop() cleanly closes all coordination modules and the PartitionedStore. Added --partitioned (default: enabled) and --legacy-db CLI flags.
changes: Added import blocks for PartitionedStore, CoordinatorDashboard, HelpProtocol, DirectChannels, WorkStealing/PipelineManager/Scratchpad with try/except fallbacks
MultiTeamRunner.__init__() now accepts partitioned=True parameter, stores enable_partitioned flag
Added instance attributes for all coordination modules (_partitioned_store, _coordinator_dashboard, _help_protocol, _direct_channels, _work_stealing, _pipeline_manager, _scratchpad)
init_environment() creates PartitionedStore(db_dir=_DB_DIR) when partitioned mode enabled, passes ps to all module constructors
stop() closes all coordination modules and PartitionedStore before closing the legacy shared connection
main() passes args.partitioned to MultiTeamRunner constructor
Bus event 'environment-initialised' now includes partitioned flag

backwards_compatibility: All modules maintain full backwards compatibility. When partitioned_store is None, each module creates its own connection to db_path (monolithic mode). Connection ownership is tracked via _owns_conn flag to prevent double-close issues.

cli_flags.--legacy-db: Fall back to monolithic single-database mode
